$schema: Darwesh Group brand tokens -- flat, framework-agnostic hex values
$note: These are aliases onto colors already live in the website's CSS, not new colors. Keep this file in lockstep with css/profile-tokens.css by hand -- there is no build step generating either from the other.

navy.role: Dominant luxury surface -- primary brand color, backgrounds, headers, CTAs

gold.role: Controlled accent -- CTAs, selected state, the one warm note against navy. Use sparingly.

ivory.role: Primary light text/surface -- warm off-white for text on navy and glow accents

neutralDark.role: Supporting depth -- recessed/backdrop surfaces, never the dominant color

semantic.$note: Not part of the brand palette -- state colors, kept separate on purpose so brand restyling never touches meaning.
